fields.Name: ORD-36 - Concessions
fields.Description: Concessions valued however they are delivered, and approved before the customer sees them (CS1-CS8). The sales guardrails used to value a concession only as a percentage off price, so a term extended at no charge computed to 0% and cleared every check. A booked term's dates are fixed, so an extension is recorded as a Duration concession, valued at the term's amount over its length and judged on both value and length. Outside a rep's SalesAuthority a concession waits for a holder of the ConcessionLimit rule's role; an order carrying one, or a typed price below the engine's that no approved concession covers, cannot be confirmed until it is decided. A manual discount inside its percentage cap still escalates on its absolute value.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Moving a booked term's end date is refused with a pointer to Duration concessions; a 90-day extension of a 1200 term is Pending at 1200 x 90 / term days and holds the order's documents; a 14-day extension inside both limits is Approved on save and stamps the authority; a user without the rule's role cannot approve, a holder can, and a decision is not reopened; with no ConcessionLimit rule the concession is refused; a draft line typed at 60 against an engine price of 100 holds the confirm until a Price concession of 80 is approved; a Pending seats concession holds the confirm and withdrawing it releases the order; a 10% manual discount worth 100 escalates past a 50 value limit.
